description:
Narrow-leafed lupin (Lupinus angustifolius) genetic map: 9,972 markers (DArTseq SNP/PAV, Fluidigm SNP, indel,
SSR, gene-based) and domestication loci (Tardus and Lentus pod shattering, Leucospermus white flower/seed,
Iucundus low alkaloid, Mollis soft seed, Ku vernalisation independence, Lanr1 anthracnose resistance) on the
97L380 RIL map (83A:476 x P27255), with positions on the Tanjil reference (= Ensembl Plants lupinus_angustifolius,
LG01-LG20) and Medicago Mt4.0 hits. Search by marker name (exact or prefix), trait words (e.g. 'alkaloid',
'pod shattering'), Tanjil region (chromosome LGxx + start/end) or map interval (chromosome + cm_start/cm_end).
For trait loci and unplaced markers the physical interval comes from the nearest anchored map neighbours, with
genes_in_region arguments.
name: lupin_markers
